headline: TYLsemi's retained IVR role links Verilog-A/RNM models, co-simulation and power-control checks
fact: An employer-attributed TYLsemi LinkedIn role observed October 25, 2026 describes high-current integrated-voltage-regulator verification. It assigns Verilog-A and SystemVerilog RNM models for power stages, integrated inductors, the power-delivery network and analog blocks; analog/digital co-simulation; and testbenches for load transients, loop stability, ripple, protection and startup/shutdown. Duties also include PVT/Monte Carlo regressions and simulation-to-lab correlation. The first publication date is unconfirmed, so this Event uses the observation date of the retained advertisement, not a claimed October hiring launch.
